prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and whether you need digital, branding, advertising, PR, B2B demand gen, etc.

Two widely recognized Kansas City agencies (good starting points)
- VML (global, Kansas City–rooted): large integrated agency that handles big national/global brand work, digital product and omnichannel campaigns. Good if you need scale and enterprise-level capabilities.  
- Barkley (KC-based, independent): strong creative and brand work, known for strategic campaigns and advertising for regional and national clients.

How I can help next
- If you tell me: your goal (brand launch, lead gen, ecommerce growth, TV/OOH campaign), industry, monthly/annual budget, and preferred agency size (boutique vs large), I’ll give a tailored shortlist of 4–6 Kansas City agencies that match and include why each fits, typical pricing range, and a suggested first question to ask them.

Quick checklist to evaluate agencies
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (ROI, revenue lift, CPA, etc.)  
- Experience in your industry or with similar business models  
- Transparency on pricing and scope (retainers, hourly, project)  
- Team makeup and primary contacts (will you get senior people?)  
- Reporting cadence and KPIs they measure  
- Client references and retention rate  
- Cultural fit and communication style

Want me to build a tailored shortlist now? If so, tell me: what are you trying to achieve, what’s your annual/quarterly marketing budget, and what industry are you in?
